specs.Compatible Devices: Android phones and tablets, macOS computers, Windows computers, devices with USB-C port or adapter

features: A UNIFIED FAN EXPERIENCE-These official licensed drives deliver seamless connectivity — bringing fans, memories, and the beautiful game closer together.
REP YOUR NATION-Each design is inspired by both the FIFA World Cup overall or one of its host countries. With an included lanyard, it's easy to wear your team spirit anywhere.
ALL SPEED. NO PENALTIES- Transfer photos, videos, and captured game moments in a flash with read speeds up to 300MB/s.
PASS FROM PHONE TO PC- Move files seamlessly across compatible Android phones and tablets, laptops, and more with the speed and flexibility of a USB-C connector

STAY IN THE ZONE- SANDISK Memory Zone mobile app for compatible Android devices and desktop app for macOS or Windows computers helps you more easily view, move, copy, help secure with password protection, and automatically back up your FIFA World Cup photos and videos.
